title_en: Borrowing the Road to Attack Guo
full_text_zh:
[P1] 假道伐虢

[P2] 春秋时期，晋国旁边有两个小国——虞国和虢国。晋献公早就想吞并这两个国家，也出兵攻打过。可是，这两个国家关系很好，就像亲兄弟，只要他们攻打其中一个，另一个立刻就会来帮忙。如果同时攻打两个国家，晋国双拳难敌四手，还不知道结果会怎么样呢！所以，晋献公很苦恼。怎样才能轻轻松松地攻下虞国和虢国呢？

[P3] 晋献公左思右想了大半年，饭也吃不香，觉也睡不好。晋国大臣荀息知道了他的烦恼后，笑着说："大王，这并不是什么难事呀！"晋献公一听就来了精神，紧盯着荀息问道："哦，你有什么好办法？"

[P4] "大王有两件稀世珍宝，只要您舍得把它们送给虞公，就可以向他借条路，去攻打虢国了。虞公收了您的宝贝，当然也就不好意思再帮虢国了。" "还需要两件稀世珍宝？" 晋献公接着问，"是哪两件宝贝？"

[P5] "就是大王最喜欢的美玉和骏马呀！只要把它们送给虞公……"
"不行！那可不行！"没等荀息把话说完，晋献公就跳起来大叫道，
"垂棘产的美玉，晶莹透亮，光彩夺目，是祖传的宝贝。屈邑送来的骏马，又高又壮，能日行千里，我自己都舍不得骑！这两件宝贝，都不能送！"

[P6] 哈哈，
都是我的啦！
"再说了，万一他收了我的宝贝，却不肯借路怎么办？"晋献公珍爱自己的宝贝，舍不得送人。
"大王放心吧，如果虞公不想借路，一定不会收您的宝贝。如果他收了，就能借给我们一条路，那虞国迟早也是您的。"

[P7] "送美玉给虞公，就像您从宫中的宝库把它取出来，放到宫外的宝库里一样；送骏马给虞公，就像您从宫中的马厩里将它牵出来，拴到了宫外的马厩里一样。虞公只是给您暂时保管着，等灭了虢国，宝贝不就回来了吗？您完全不用担心！"

[P8] 晋献公听完了荀息的话，知道他这个办法非常妙，只好小心翼翼地将垂棘美玉取出来，用最柔软的丝绸擦了一遍又一遍。他又来到马厩，亲手为四匹屈邑骏马洗了澡，刷了毛。然后，他才百般不舍地将它们交给了荀息。

[P9] 荀息背着美玉，牵着骏马，来到了虞国。虞公见了荀息送上的美玉和骏马，高兴得不得了，嘴里不停地赞叹：“宝贝啊！真是无价之宝！”他一会儿摸摸美玉，一会儿拍拍骏马，笑得合不拢嘴。可是他转念一想，又担心起来：这晋献公要是改变主意，再把宝贝要回去怎么办？

[P10] 于是，虞公问荀息："这美玉和骏马，都是晋国的镇国之宝，你们的国君怎么会舍得送给我呀？贵国一定是有什么事，需要我帮忙吧？" 荀息叹了口气说："这么久没见，我们国君很想念您，这些薄礼只是一点心意。最近，因为虢国侵犯我们的边境，国君很烦恼，确实有一点小事想请您帮忙！"

[P11] 虞公听说要他帮忙，小心地放下手里的美玉，问道："是什么事呢？"
"您能不能借一条路给我们，让我们去教训一下虢国？如果这一仗打赢了，缴获的战利品，我们都送给您。"荀息道。
"只借一条路吗？没问题啊，可以！"只帮晋国这么一点小忙，就可以得到两件宝贝，虞公的头点得像小鸡啄米似的，满口答应了。

[P12] 但是，虞国大臣宫之奇却不同意借路，他劝虞公说："大王，您不能答应呀！虞国和虢国的关系，就像嘴唇和牙齿，互相保护。如果没有嘴唇，牙齿就要受冻；如果虢国早晨灭亡，虞国晚上就会被消灭。大王，您千万要想清楚啊！"

[P13] 虞公手捧美玉，对着阳光细细地瞧着，说：‘这么贵重的宝贝，晋国都送给我了，如果我连条路都舍不得借，那也太小气了吧！而且，晋国比虢国强大十倍，就算失去了虢国，我能跟更厉害的晋国做朋友，这有什么不好呢？’宫之奇见虞公被美玉、骏马迷昏了头，知道虞国就快要灭亡了，便带着全族的人离开了虞国。

[P14] 晋国大军借了虞国的一条近路，只用了四个月的时间，就攻占了虢国。晋军抢了很多金银财宝，回去时路过虞国，全部送给了虞公。看到这么多金银财宝，虞公高兴得嘴角都咧到耳朵了。晋军大将趁机说："我们的主帅病了，没有力气领兵回国，您能不能让我们的大军，在虞国的都城外驻扎几天？"虞公想都没想就答应了。

[P15] 几天后，晋献公忽然来到虞国，约虞公一起去打猎。虞公连忙带着全城的兵马，浩浩荡荡地出了城。他们玩得正高兴时，突然远远看到城中冒起了滚滚的浓烟。虞公急匆匆地往回赶，来到城外，只见一名晋国大将站在高高的城墙上，威风凛凛地向他喊道：‘虞公，上次您借给我们一条路，这次再把虞国借给我们吧！哈哈哈！’虞公这才恍然大悟，但是一切都晚了。

[P16] 灭了虞国，晋献公急忙问荀息："我的美玉呢？我的骏马呢？"荀息拿着美玉、牵着骏马走过来，笑着对晋献公说："美玉还是跟以前一样漂亮，骏马又长了两颗牙齿，更强壮了呢！"晋国先向虞国借道，消灭了虢国；回过头来，晋国又把虞国消灭了。这个计策，就是人们常说的"假道伐虢"。
full_text_en:
[P1] Borrowing a Path to Attack Guo

[P2] In the Spring and Autumn period, there were two small states beside the State of Jin — Yu and Guo. Duke Xian of Jin had long wanted to annex these two states and had even launched attacks before. However, these two states had a very close relationship, like亲 brothers; whenever one was attacked, the other would immediately come to its aid. If Jin attacked both at the same time, it would be like 'two fists against four hands' — and the outcome was uncertain. Therefore, Duke Xian was very troubled. How could he easily conquer both Yu and Guo?

[P3] King Xian of Jin had been thinking hard for half a year, unable to eat or sleep well. When Minister Xun Xi of Jin learned of his worries, he smiled and said: "Your Majesty, this is not a difficult matter at all!" King Xian immediately perked up, staring intently at Xun Xi and asked: "Oh, what good idea do you have?"

[P4] "Your Majesty, you have two rare treasures. If you are willing to give them to King Yu, you can borrow his path to attack the State of Guo. Once King Yu receives your treasures, he will naturally feel embarrassed to help Guo anymore." "Two rare treasures?" King Jin Xian asked, "Which two treasures?"

[P5] "These are the king's favorite jade and fine horse! Just give them to King Yu..."
"No! That's impossible!" Before Xun Xi could finish speaking, King Xian of Jin jumped up and shouted,
"The jade from Chuji is clear and bright, dazzling in its brilliance—it's a family heirloom. The horse from Quyi is tall and strong, capable of traveling a thousand miles in a day. I myself wouldn't even ride it! These two treasures, I cannot give away!"

[P6] Haha,
They're all mine!
"Besides, what if he takes my treasures but refuses to lend us the road?" King Xian of Jin cherished his treasures and was reluctant to give them away.
"Your Majesty, rest assured. If King Yu doesn't want to lend us the road, he certainly won't accept your treasures. But if he does accept them, he will lend us the road. Then, the State of Yu will surely be yours in time."

[P7] "Giving the beautiful jade to King Yu is like taking it out of your palace treasury and placing it in a treasury outside the palace. Giving the fine horse to King Yu is like leading it out of your palace stables and tying it up in stables outside the palace. King Yu is merely keeping them for you temporarily. Once we destroy the State of Guo, won't the treasures be returned to you? You have nothing to worry about!"

[P8] After hearing Xun Xi's plan, Duke Xian of Jin realized it was brilliant. Reluctantly, he carefully took out the precious Chuiji jade and wiped it over and over again with the softest silk. Then he went to the stables, personally bathed and brushed the four fine horses from Quyi. Finally, with great reluctance, he handed them over to Xun Xi.

[P9] Xun Xi carried the beautiful jade and led the fine horse to the state of Yu. King Yu, upon seeing the jade and horse presented by Xun Xi, was overjoyed and kept exclaiming, "Treasures! Truly priceless gems!" He would stroke the jade for a while, then pat the horse, laughing with delight. But then he thought to himself and grew worried: What if Duke Xian of Jin changes his mind and demands the treasures back?

[P10] Then, King Yu asked Xun Xi: "These fine jade and fine horses are the national treasures of Jin. How could your ruler possibly part with them for me? Your country must have something you need me to help with, right?" Xun Xi sighed and said: "It's been so long since we last met. Our ruler misses you very much. These small gifts are just a token of our feelings. Recently, because the state of Guo has invaded our borders, our ruler is very troubled. There's indeed a small matter we'd like to ask for your help with!"

[P11] Yu Gong, upon hearing that he was being asked for help, carefully put down the beautiful jade in his hand and asked, "What is it about?"
"Could you lend us a path, so we can go and teach Guo State a lesson? If we win this battle, all the spoils of war will be given to you," said Xun Xi.
"Just lending a path? No problem at all, yes!" With such a small favor for Jin State, he could get two precious treasures. Yu Gong nodded his head like a chick pecking at grain, readily agreeing.

[P12] But the minister of Yu, Gong Zhiqi, disagreed with lending the road. He advised King Yu: "Your Majesty, you must not agree! The relationship between Yu and Guo is like lips and teeth, protecting each other. Without lips, teeth will freeze; if Guo perishes in the morning, Yu will be destroyed by night. Your Majesty, you must think this through carefully!"

[P13] The King of Yu held the beautiful jade in his hands, examining it carefully in the sunlight, and said: 'Such a precious treasure, and Jin has given it to me! If I can't even lend them a path, that would be too stingy! Moreover, Jin is ten times stronger than Guo. Even if I lose Guo, I can become friends with the more powerful Jin. What's wrong with that?' Gong Zhiqi saw that the King of Yu was dazzled by the jade and fine horses, and realized that the state of Yu was about to fall. He then left Yu with his entire family.

[P14] The Jin army borrowed a shortcut from the State of Yu and, in just four months, conquered the State of Guo. The Jin troops seized a great deal of gold and treasure, and on their return journey, passed through Yu and gave all of it to Lord Yu. Seeing so much treasure, Lord Yu was so delighted that his smile reached his ears. The Jin general then took the opportunity to say, "Our commander is ill and lacks the strength to lead the troops back home. Could you allow our army to camp outside your capital for a few days?" Lord Yu didn't even think twice before agreeing.

[P15] A few days later, Jin Xian Gong suddenly arrived in Yu State, inviting Lord Yu to go hunting together. Lord Yu hurriedly led the entire city's troops out in a grand procession. While they were enjoying themselves, they suddenly saw thick smoke rising from the city in the distance. Lord Yu rushed back, and upon arriving outside the city walls, he saw a Jin general standing tall on the city wall, proudly shouting at him: 'Lord Yu, last time you lent us a path, now lend us your entire state! Hahaha!' Lord Yu finally realized the truth, but it was already too late.

[P16] After destroying the State of Yu, Duke Xian of Jin hurriedly asked Xun Xi: "Where are my beautiful jade and my fine horses?" Xun Xi brought forward the jade and led the horse, smiling at Duke Xian and saying: "The jade is still as beautiful as before, and the horse has grown two more teeth and is even stronger!" The State of Jin first borrowed a passage from Yu to destroy the State of Guo; then, turning around, it destroyed Yu as well. This strategy is what people commonly call 'Borrowing a Path to Attack Guo.'
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页展示了成语“假道伐虢”的标题，配有一名古代男子的插图，暗示故事即将开始。
[P2] 本页介绍了春秋时期晋国想吞并虞国和虢国，但因两国关系密切、互相支援而难以得手，晋献公因此陷入苦恼。
[P3] 晋献公因无法吞并虞国和虢国而忧心忡忡，大臣荀息得知后，笑着提出可以解决，晋献公立刻精神起来，询问其计策。
[P4] 荀息向晋献公献计，建议用两件稀世珍宝贿赂虞公，借道攻打虢国，晋献公询问具体是哪两件宝贝。
[P5] 荀息建议用美玉和骏马贿赂虞公以借道攻打虢国，晋献公因珍视这两件宝物而坚决反对，表示自己都舍不得用，更不能送人。
[P6] 晋献公担心贿赂虞公后对方不借路，荀息则解释说，虞公若收下宝物就一定会借路，否则不会接受，以此打消晋献公的顾虑。
[P7] 荀息向晋献公解释，送宝物给虞公如同暂时借出，待灭虢国后宝物自然归还，以此打消晋献公的顾虑。
[P8] 晋献公在听完荀息的计策后，虽万分不舍，但仍精心准备了垂棘美玉和四匹屈邑骏马，并亲手清洗擦拭后交给了荀息，准备用于贿赂虞公以借道伐虢。
[P9] 荀息带着美玉和骏马来到虞国，虞公起初欣喜若狂，但随即担心晋献公日后会索回宝物。
[P10] 虞公收到晋国送来的美玉和骏马，怀疑晋国另有图谋，荀息则以国君思念为由，委婉请求虞公帮忙，暗示有要事相求。
[P11] 荀息向虞公提出借道攻打虢国的请求，并承诺战利品全数奉送。虞公贪图美玉和骏马，欣然同意借路。
[P12] 虞国大臣宫之奇劝谏虞公不要借路给晋国，指出虞虢两国唇齿相依，若虢国灭亡，虞国也将难保。
[P13] 虞公贪图晋国送来的美玉和骏马，不顾大臣劝谏，同意借道给晋国攻打虢国；大臣宫之奇预见虞国将亡，遂带族人离开。
[P14] 晋国借道虞国攻灭虢国后，将抢夺的财宝赠予虞公，虞公欣喜若狂。晋军大将趁机请求在虞国都城外驻扎，虞公不假思索便答应了。
[P15] 晋献公借打猎之名来到虞国，趁虞公外出时率军攻占虞国，虞公回城后才明白被骗，但为时已晚。
[P16] 晋国借道虞国灭虢后，又趁机灭掉虞国，荀息将美玉和骏马归还晋献公，晋献公大喜，此计被称为‘假道伐虢’。
